LingBot-VA: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cec7b7a6-953b-4fa4-8f1a-47efc1fce547 ## Table of Contents - [News](#-news) - [Model Download](#-model-download) - [Quick Start](#️-quick-start) - [Installation](#installation) - [attn_mode Configuration](#️-important-attn_mode-configuration) - [Deploying LingBot-VA for Inference](#deploying-lingbot-va-for-inference) - [Evaluation on RoboTwin-2.0](#evaluation-on-robotwin-20) - [Evaluation on LIBERO](#evaluation-on-libero) - [Run Image to Video-Action Generation](#run-image-to-video-action-generation) - [Post-Training LingBot-VA](#post-training-lingbot-va) - [Data Preparation](#data-preparation) - [Custom Dataset Preparation](#custom-dataset-preparation) - [Training](#training) - [Performance](#-performance) - [Simulation Evaluation](#simulation-evaluation) - [Real-world Deployment](#real-world-deployment) - [License](#-license) - [Citation](#citation) - [Acknowledgments](#-acknowledgments) --- ## 💫 Meet **LingBot-VA**! We've built an AR diffusion framework for simultaneous world modeling and action! 🤖✨ **LingBot-VA** has focused on: - **Autoregressive Video-Action World Modeling**: Architecturally unifies visual dynamics prediction and action inference within a single interleaved sequence while maintaining their conceptual distinction. - **High-efficiency Execution**: A dual-stream mixture-of-transformers(MoT) architecture with Asynchronous Execution and KV Cache. - **Long-Horizon Performance and Generalization**: High improvements in sample efficiency, long-horizon success rates, and generalization to novel scenes. # 🚀 News - **[2026-04-24]** Weights for post-train on **LIBERO-LONG** released! (**IMPORTANT**: Ensure that `va_libero_cfg.action_snr_shift`, `va_libero_cfg.used_action_channel_ids` and `va_libero_cfg.norm_stat` in [`wan_va/configs/va_libero_cfg.py`](wan_va/configs/va_libero_cfg.py) are synchronized with the latest version of the repository.) - **[2026-04-08]**
abstract_zh: 我们提出了LingBot-VA，一个自回归扩散框架，用于同时进行世界建模和动作生成。该框架在架构上统一了视觉动态预测和动作推理，将它们交织在单个序列中，同时保持概念上的区分。通过双流混合Transformer（MoT）架构、异步执行和KV缓存，实现了高效执行。在长时域任务中，LingBot-VA在样本效率、长时域成功率和泛化到新场景方面均有显著提升。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出自回归扩散框架：将视觉动态预测与动作推理交错排布在单一序列中统一建模，并采用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构，配合异步执行（Asynchronous Execution）与 KV Cache 实现高效推理。


# 一、动机

> 通用机器人控制中，视觉动力学预测与动作推理通常被割裂建模，导致长时程任务成功率低、样本效率差、难以泛化到新场景；LingBot-VA 试图在同一框架内同时完成世界建模与动作生成。


# 二、方法

> 提出自回归扩散框架：将视觉动态预测与动作推理交错排布在单一序列中统一建模，并采用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构，配合异步执行（Asynchronous Execution）与 KV Cache 实现高效推理。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在 RoboTwin-2.0 与 LIBERO 两个仿真基准上完成评测，并开源了 LIBERO-LONG 的后训练权重（2026-04-24 发布）；作者声称在样本效率、长时程任务成功率和对新场景的泛化上有显著提升，但摘要与 README 未给出具体数值指标。


# 四、对我的启发

> 把 video-action world model 做成自回归交错序列、再叠加 MoT + 异步执行 + KV Cache，是目前具身控制里较有工程参考价值的路线；局限在于公开材料缺少量化对比（成功率、样本量、推理延迟）与真机部署细节，需读论文正文或复现后才能判断实际收益。
